summary: Splash Damage and Bethesda's Brink is a class-based parkour shooter designed around seamless solo, co-op, and multiplayer play.

entries.title: Brink

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current Steam PC build with server/player state documented

primary.version: Current free Steam release with DLC/server state documented
primary.why: Brink remains available on Steam as a free PC route, and PC is the best capture/settings platform for its class, objective, SMART movement, bot, and multiplayer systems. Online population/server state is volatile, so solo/bot and any live multiplayer captures must be labeled.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam PC release. Record build, DLC ownership/install state, character/body type, class, map, campaign side, difficulty, bot count, server/LAN/online state, player count, controller or keyboard/mouse, and graphics settings.

secondary.exclusive_content: Console route and original couch-era context
secondary.why: PC is free/current and easier to capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC and online/server state; bot/solo capture is not the same as a full launch-era multiplayer match.
